abstract: The study dealt with anti-tumor and adverse effects of etoposide and cisplatin on human choriocarcinoma cell line (GCH-1) transplantable in nude mice in relation to the rate of their uptake into tumor tissue. Nude mice were divided into 3 groups (etoposide, cisplatin and MTX-group), 7 to 9 per group and received drug treatment which started when their tumor grew to 100 approximately 300 mm3 in volume. All drugs were intraperitoneally administrated to nude mice (each drug: 1/4 mouse LD50 dose X3, weekly). The inhibiting action on the tumor was observed to be etoposide greater than cisplatin greater than MTX. The body weight loss of nude mice was observed to at its maximum in the cisplatin-treated group. The serum beta-HCG level did not rise in the drug-treated groups but rose in the non-treated control group. No histopathological changes characteristic of each drug were found. A concentration of etoposide and cisplatin in various tissues was serially measured after one shot intraperitoneal injection of etoposide 25 mg/kg or cisplatin 5 mg/kg. Etoposide reached its peak concentration after 30 minutes in tumor, liver and kidney and, after 4 hours, was left with 37.1%, 10.4% and 2.3% concentrations after 30 minutes in tumor, liver and kidney, respectively. Cisplatin showed similar kinetics, but was found to remain at a comparatively high concentration in both liver and kidney. Thus, it was demonstrated that etoposide and cisplatin were active against the human choriocarcinoma cell line. Furthermore, the less adverse effect of etoposide was felt to be partially due to its lower residue in liver and kidney.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、ヌードマウスに移植可能なヒト絨毛癌細胞株(GCH-1)に対するエトポシドおよびシスプラチンの抗腫瘍作用と副作用を、腫瘍組織への薬剤移行率との関連で検討した。ヌードマウスを、エトポシド群、シスプラチン群、MTX群の3群（各群7～9匹）に分け、腫瘍が100～300 mm3に増大した時点で治療を開始した。全薬剤を腹腔内投与した（各薬剤：マウスLD50の1/4量を週1回、計3回）。腫瘍抑制作用はエトポシド>シスプラチン>MTXの順であった。ヌードマウスの体重減少はシスプラチン投与群で最も大きかった。血清β-hCG値は薬剤投与群では上昇しなかったが、無治療の対照群では上昇した。各薬剤に特徴的な組織学的変化は認められなかった。エトポシド25 mg/kgまたはシスプラチン5 mg/kgを単回腹腔内投与後、各組織中の薬剤濃度を経時的に測定した。エトポシドは腫瘍、肝臓、腎臓において30分後に最高濃度に達し、4時間後には30分時点の濃度のそれぞれ37.1%、10.4%、2.3%が残存していた。シスプラチンも同様の動態を示したが、肝臓と腎臓では比較的高濃度に留まった。以上より、エトポシドとシスプラチンはヒト絨毛癌細胞株に対して有効であることが示された。さらに、エトポシドの副作用が比較的少ないのは、肝臓および腎臓への残留が少ないことが一因と考えられた。
